fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (failed URLs are not written to the dataset -- they are reported in the ERRORS record of the run's key-value store). Article-mode records (S1-jsonld+html) carry headline/articleBody-style fields; latest-mode records (S2-rss) carry title/link-style fields.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (e.g. S1-jsonld+html, S2-rss).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

description.title: Description
description.description: Article dek/description. On latest-mode (RSS) records this is the RSS item's <description> instead (often empty).

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full article text, joined from div.text > div.text-long paragraph blocks (concatenated across all blocks for longform/syndicated pieces).

author.title: Author
author.description: Author name, extracted from the ld+json author object's 'name' field.

image.title: Image
image.description: Lead image URL, extracted from the ld+json image object's 'url' field.

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline from the RSS item (latest mode).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
